actual_author_read_scope: Complete scientific main body in wholepage transformation, excluding Table3 homolog listing; all conclusions below have inspected Methods/Results/Discussion locators. No structure-figure raster inspection.

claims.locator: Introduction; gene cloning; Discussion final paragraph
claims.paraphrase: The authors use AmnE for AP3 2-aminomuconate deaminase. They lacked AP3 cells, used a synthetic gene and reported no enzyme-activity assay because unstable substrate production failed.
Recombinant AmnE was produced in BL21(DE3)pLysS from pET28a; purification included nickel affinity, thrombin tag removal, ion exchange and size exclusion.
The 142-residue deaminase structure 6IZH has nine asymmetric-unit protomers; the biological interpretation is a hexamer, supported by an approximately 103.5 kDa solution estimate.
R56A and deletion49–59 favored trimers; P126A remained hexameric. These are deaminase assembly experiments, not evidence for decarboxylase/hydratase stoichiometry.

limits: The structural paper does not resolve the 2000 purified-enzyme assignment conflict by an activity experiment.
Do not transfer deaminase hexamer, interface residues or mutation outcomes to 4-OD or hydratase.
Full biological-identity reconciliation is a sibling author task.
